title: Hermes 使用量の概要

panels.title: 合計トークン
panels.description: 選択した期間・対象の既知使用量。cacheは入力、reasoningは出力の内数。未知値を0とみなさず、サブスク残量や料金へ換算しません。

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(total_tokens)::bigint AS "合計トークン" FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring})

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(input_tokens)::bigint AS "入力トークン（cache含む）" FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring})

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(output_tokens)::bigint AS "出力トークン（reasoning含む）" FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring})

panels.description: 観測したrequest attempt数。retryを含み、ユーザー発言数とは異なります。

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "リクエスト" FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring})

panels.title: ユーザー別トークン
panels.description: 対象でDiscord利用と自律処理を切替。systemや帰属不明を特定ユーザーへ配分しません。

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE user_id WHEN 'system' THEN 'system（自律処理）' WHEN 'unattributed' THEN 'unattributed（帰属不明）' ELSE user_id END AS "Metric", sum(total_tokens)::double precision AS "Value" FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring}) GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY "Value" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: モデル別トークン比率
panels.description: 選択対象の既知トークンをモデル別に集計。

targets.rawSql: SELECT now() AS time, COALESCE(model,'未取得') AS metric, sum(total_tokens)::double precision AS value FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring}) GROUP BY model ORDER BY value DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: ユーザー別トークン推移（JST）
panels.description: 集計単位day/hourで日別・時間帯別を切替。記録のない時間帯を利用0で補完しません。

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc(${bucket:sqlstring},occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo' AS time, CASE user_id WHEN 'system' THEN 'system（自律処理）' WHEN 'unattributed' THEN 'unattributed（帰属不明）' ELSE user_id END AS metric, sum(total_tokens)::bigint AS value FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: ユーザー別の内訳・割合
panels.description: 割合は選択中の既知Discord使用量を分母にします。system/帰属不明には割合を付けません。

targets.rawSql:
WITH u AS (
        SELECT user_id, sum(input_tokens)::bigint AS input, sum(output_tokens)::bigint AS output,
        sum(total_tokens)::bigint AS tokens, count(*) AS attempts,
        count(DISTINCT turn_id) FILTER(WHERE parent_turn_id IS NULL AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') AS user_turns,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE quality!='reported') AS incomplete
        FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring}) GROUP BY user_id)
        SELECT user_id AS "ユーザー", user_turns AS "入力turn", attempts AS "リクエスト",
        input AS "入力", output AS "出力", tokens AS "合計",
        CASE WHEN user_id LIKE 'discord:%' THEN round(100.0*tokens/NULLIF(sum(tokens) FILTER(WHERE user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OVER(),0),2) END AS "Discord内の割合(%)",
        incomplete AS "usage未取得" FROM u ORDER BY tokens DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: スレッド別トークン・利用者
panels.description: 上部のユーザー・スレッドで絞り込めます。session/turn/requestの識別子は明細画面で確認できます。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(thread_id,'なし（channel/DM）') AS "スレッド", user_id AS "ユーザー", instance AS "環境",
        count(*) AS "リクエスト", sum(total_tokens)::bigint AS "合計トークン"
        FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY "合計トークン" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: モデル別cache-read割合
panels.description: cache-readが報告されたrequestの入力tokenを分母にした内数割合。未知cacheを0として扱いません。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(model,'未取得') AS "Metric",
        (100.0*sum(cache_read_tokens)/NULLIF(sum(input_tokens) FILTER(WHERE cache_read_tokens IS NOT NULL),0))::double precision AS "Value"
        FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring}) GROUP BY model ORDER BY "Value" DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: 取得品質・エラー
panels.description: reported=入力/出力を取得、partial=一部のみ、missing=usage未取得。観測できなかったrequest数は含められません。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT quality AS "usage品質", outcome AS "結果", count(*) AS "リクエスト", sum(total_tokens)::bigint AS "既知トークン"
        FROM grafana.requests WHERE source='hermes' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND ('__all' IN (${instance:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(instance,'none') IN (${instance:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(model,'none') IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${user:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(user_id,'none') IN (${user:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${thread:sqlstring}) OR COALESCE(thread_id,'none') IN (${thread:sqlstring})) AND (${scope:sqlstring}='all' OR (${scope:sqlstring}='discord' AND user_id LIKE 'discord:%') OR user_id=${scope:sqlstring}) GROUP BY quality,outcome ORDER BY quality,outcome

panels.title: 計測開始・最終受信
panels.description: 期間filter外も含む全計測範囲。Windowsの新ledgerのみで、以前の保存データは未取込です。最終受信が古いだけで利用ゼロとは判断しません。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT instance AS "環境",measurement_start AS "計測開始",last_event AS "最終イベント",last_received AS "最終受信",incomplete_records AS "未取得件数"
        FROM grafana.usage_health WHERE source='hermes' ORDER BY instance
